'''BCA-11/X lightsaber practice droid''', also known as '''BCA-11/X training droid''', was a droid model produced by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] as a [[Training droid/Legends|training droid]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] matrix in the bonding of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Quadranium/Legends|quadranium]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] allowed it to resist the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and made it harder to destroy. The droids were equipped with [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]].

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' calls this droid both "BCA-11/X lightsaber practice droid" and "BCA-11/X training droid" on the same page.
